title: Festivals and visits
goal: Greet people at Diwali, the New Year, Uttarayan and Navratri, and handle a family visit gracefully.
tip: The Gujarati New Year is બેસતું વર્ષ, the day after Diwali, and the greeting is સાલ મુબારક or, more formally, નૂતન વર્ષાભિનંદન. When you visit, you touch elders' feet (પગે લાગવું) and they bless you. Sweets come with the line મોં મીઠું કરો, "sweeten your mouth".

items.notes: Literally "the year that sets in", as in ચોમાસું બેઠું (the monsoon has set in): the first day of the Gujarati year.
The everyday New Year greeting, said all through the first days after Diwali.
The formal version, for cards and messages.
Every January 14th, when the whole of Gujarat goes up on the roof to fly kites.
Nine nights of garba in honour of the goddess.
The shout from the roof when your kite cuts someone else's string. It gave the film Kai Po Che! its name.

items.english: Come on, let's go and dance garba!
alts: Come on, let's go for garba!

items.notes: The respectful greeting to grandparents and elders, especially at festivals.
What you say as you bend down. Ba will usually answer with a blessing.

items.english: May you live to be a hundred!
alts: May you live a hundred years!

items.notes: શું જરૂર છે? what's the need? But જરૂર આવજો means do come, definitely.
Literally "sweeten your mouth", said when sharing sweets for good news or a festival.

items.english: What was the need for this?
alts: Why did you go to the trouble
items.notes: What everyone says on being handed a gift, the way English says "you shouldn't have!"

items.gujarati: દિવાળીમાં અમે દીવા કરીએ છીએ અને રંગોળી પૂરીએ છીએ.
items.translit: divaaLeemaan ame deevaa kariye chhiye ane rangoLee pooriye chhiye.
items.english: At Diwali we light lamps and make rangoli.
alts: At Diwali we light lamps and draw rangoli
items.notes: દીવા કરવા, to light lamps. રંગોળી પૂરવી, to fill in a rangoli with coloured powder.

items.gujarati: નવરાત્રિમાં નવ રાત ગરબા થાય છે.
items.translit: navraatrimaan nav raat garbaa thaay chhe.
items.english: In Navratri there is garba for nine nights.
alts: During Navratri there is garba for nine nights
At Navratri there is garba for nine nights

items.gujarati: ઉત્તરાયણમાં બધા ધાબા પર પતંગ ચગાવે છે.
items.translit: uttaraayaNmaan badhaa dhaabaa par patang chagaave chhe.
items.english: At Uttarayan everyone flies kites on the rooftops.
alts: At Uttarayan everyone flies kites from the roofs
On Uttarayan everyone flies kites on the roof
Goodbye, be sure to come again!
items.notes: How every host sees guests off.
